=={{header|Ada}}==
<syntaxhighlight lang="ada">loop
   Value := Value + 1;
   Put (Value);
   exit when Value mod 6 = 0;
end loop;</syntaxhighlight>
Here is an alternative version:
<syntaxhighlight lang="ada">for Value in 0..Integer'Last loop
   Put (Value);
   exit when Value mod 6 = 0;
end loop;</syntaxhighlight>
